statements.t: revenue guidance and reaffirming our earnings-per-share guidance, even as we navigate supply chain and inflationary headwinds.
• The Company expects to pay a competitive and growing dividend and to deploy 100 percent of excess cash to shareholders over time.
• The Company expects full-year 2026 reported revenue growth of approximately 13.5 percent and organic revenue growth of approximately 11 percent versus full-year 2025.
• The Company expects GAAP continuing EPS for full-year 2026 of approximately $15.00 to $15.10, including $0.20 for non-GAAP adjustments.
The Company expects adjusted continuing EPS for full- year 2026 of $15.20 to $15.30.
• Additional information regarding the Company's 2026 guidance is included in the Company's third-quarter earnings presentation found at www.tranetechnologies.com in the Investor Relations section.
